title: feat(tui): halt live-agents dock clock while collapsed
claim: While the live-agents dock is collapsed, its 1 s clock must not re-render the dock for agent elapsed the collapsed line never shows, but process rows (whose 'exit N · Ns ago' text and PROCESS_RETAIN_SECONDS expiry are clock-driven and visible collapsed) must keep it, and expanding must paint the live elapsed.

evidence.source: main ui-tui/src/components/agentsPanel.tsx:155-165 `ticking = live || processRows.length > 0` ignores $agentDockCollapsed; AgentsPanelView collapsed branch renders only `▸ counts · firstDetail · hints` (agent row detail = notes/outputTail/tools, not time-based; lib/agentRows.ts:121), but firstDetail falls back to processes.rows[0].detail = processVerdict 'exit N · Ns ago' and buildProcessRows drops exits after PROCESS_RETAIN_SECONDS using nowMs (app/processRoster.ts:70-100). Unchanged since fork merge-base 39faafb616.
evidence.measured: Real LiveAgentsPanel under vi fake timers, 1 running subagent, 10 s window, React Profiler commits / Ink onFrame frames: main collapsed 10/10, rebuild collapsed 0/0; expanded 10/10 both (clock kept).
evidence.red: agentDockCollapsedClock.test.tsx on main: test 1 'AssertionError: expected [ 10, 10 ] to deeply equal [ +0, +0 ]'; test 2 (process ageing) passes on main.
evidence.fork_head_reproof: Exact fork-head agentsPanel.tsx (9433e49f81 == closed upstream #127466 head) on main: test 2 FAILS 'expected \'[top]\n▸ 1 done · exit 0 · 5s ago · C…\' to contain \'exit 0 · 8s ago\'' -> fork halts the clock for process rows too, so a collapsed dock freezes the exited-process verdict and never ages it out (visible regression). Fork's PR-body premise 'collapsed chrome shows counts + first activity only (no per-row elapsed)' is false for process verdicts.
evidence.green: Rebuild (ticking = processRows.length > 0 || (live && !collapsed); re-seed now on (re)arm): 2/2 pass; 5x repeat + shuffle green.
evidence.negative_control: NC1 drop `&& !collapsed` -> test 1 fails [10,10]; NC2 fork rule `!collapsed && (live || processRows.length > 0)` -> test 2 fails (frozen '5s ago'); NC3 drop re-seed -> test 1 fails ('probe auth 12s' after expand).
evidence.adjacent: agentsDock, agentsCompact, processDock, agentsHydration, agentRoster, agentControls, subagentTree, appChromeBlockedTimers + new file: 9 files / 76 tests pass. npm run typecheck clean; eslint + prettier clean on touched files. Combined tree (rebuild + #129526 head + #129556 head + fork-303 rebuild): new tests, uiThemeSubscription, sidBusySubscriptionNarrow, processDock, agentsDock 6 files/13 tests pass, typecheck clean. NOT_TESTED: full-app frame rate/CPU in a real terminal (numbers are isolated-dock), manual Ctrl+R in live TUI.
